# Hasmik's Club

> Hasmik's Club is a curated women's community in Yerevan, Armenia, for
> Armenian women 50 and older — intimate gatherings, cultural events, and a
> circle of like-minded women. Regular meetups happen roughly every two
> weeks in cafés, gardens, and galleries around Yerevan, alongside a private
> Telegram group for members. Membership works via one-time credit packages
> (buy a set number of event credits, use them to RSVP) rather than a
> recurring subscription.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://www.hasmiksclub.am/): overview of the club, its founder
  Hasmik, and membership packages.
- [Events](https://www.hasmiksclub.am/events): upcoming gatherings members
  can RSVP to.
- [About](https://www.hasmiksclub.am/about): the club's story and mission.
- [Contact](https://www.hasmiksclub.am/contact): how to reach the club.
- [Gift a Package](https://www.hasmiksclub.am/gift): buy a membership
  package as a gift for someone else.
- [Terms](https://www.hasmiksclub.am/terms): membership terms and
  conditions.

## Language

The site is primarily in Armenian (հայերեն), with English also available
via an in-page language toggle.
